description: This file defines an Android activity class 'Patterns' that demonstrates the use of BitmapShader and touch interaction to manipulate shader effects on a Canvas. It creates bitmaps, applies shaders, and handles touch events to move the shader patterns.

classes.name: Patterns
classes.description: An Android activity that showcases shader patterns and touch interactions.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: A custom View class that renders shader-based patterns and handles touch events to manipulate the pattern position.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the view.

methods.name: makeBitmap1
methods.description: Creates a 40x40 red background bitmap with a blue rectangle.

methods.name: makeBitmap2
methods.description: Creates a 64x64 green circle bitmap with transparency.

methods.name: SampleView constructor
methods.description: Initializes shaders, paint, and matrix for drawing.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the shader patterns onto the canvas, with translation based on touch.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch input to update the position of the shader pattern.
